acceptance.given: A Toolchain target resolution attempt has no target at the requested path.

oracle.expected: The check records a missing-target denial and terminates processing before any target content is accepted.
forbidden: Processing proceeds with a missing target.
A missing target is accepted or processed as valid.
oracle.observable: The validator or route result contains an explicit missing-target rejection/closed outcome during target resolution.

acceptance.then: Target processing remains closed and no target artifact is emitted.
acceptance.when: Run the Toolchain target-resolution validator against the missing-target selector and inspect its structured result.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a target-resolution case whose target path is absent and verify the validator must reject it before processing.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce closed failure when target resolution finds no target; the missing-target check must deny processing and emit a structured rejection.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema changes; rollback restores prior target-resolution behavior while retaining closed handling for absent targets.

slice_hint.state_transition: missing target resolution -> explicit rejection -> processing remains closed
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Validator result is a missing-target denial with no accepted target content or downstream processing.

acceptance.given: A supported VDD or Acceptance package route has completed successfully and produced effective inspected content.

oracle.expected: The success evidence records the identity or digest of the exact effective inspected content inspected by the route.
forbidden: Successful evidence is produced without binding to effective inspected content.
Evidence is bound to content other than the effective inspected content.
oracle.observable: Structured route evidence contains an effective-content reference that matches the inspected package content.

acceptance.then: The emitted success evidence is content-bound and can be independently matched to the inspected bytes.
acceptance.when: Execute the supported route and inspect the generated success evidence against the effective inspected-content identity.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a successful supported-route case and remove or mismatch its effective-content reference; the evidence binding check must fail.

affected_subjects: Successful route evidence and effective inspected content
slice_hint.behavior_change: Bind successful route evidence to the effective inspected content identity so mismatched or absent content references are rejected.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Evidence schema remains backward-compatible; rollback removes the new binding assertion without changing stored artifact formats.

slice_hint.state_transition: supported route success -> effective content identified -> content-bound evidence emitted
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Success evidence includes a matching effective inspected-content identity and rejects absent or mismatched bindings.

acceptance.given: The current Consumer Manifest and repository callers in VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing scopes are available for reconciliation.

oracle.expected: A reconciliation artifact proves every named-scope repository caller maps to a Consumer Manifest entry and every manifest entry maps back to a real caller, with all three scopes represented.
forbidden: Any repository caller lacks a corresponding Consumer Manifest entry.
The reverse reconciliation omits VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing callers.
oracle.observable: The generated reconciliation record contains complete bidirectional mappings for VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing callers.

acceptance.then: The complete current Consumer Manifest is accepted only when both directions of reconciliation are complete.
acceptance.when: Run the manifest reconciliation validator and inspect its artifact for caller-to-entry and entry-to-caller mappings across all named scopes.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a reconciliation fixture with one omitted caller or one omitted reverse manifest mapping in VDD, Acceptance, or workflow-model-routing and require validation failure.

affected_subjects: Repository callers and Consumer Manifest entries
slice_hint.behavior_change: Require complete bidirectional Consumer Manifest reconciliation against the repository real-call surface, explicitly covering VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing consumers.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No database or persisted schema change; rollback restores prior reconciliation checks.

slice_hint.state_transition: collect manifest and real callers -> reconcile both directions by scope -> accept complete mapping
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Reconciliation artifact has zero unmapped callers and zero manifest entries without callers across VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing.

acceptance.given: Rollback has completed for a non-empty Consumer Manifest.

oracle.expected: Every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry records an observation of the Prior Behavior Baseline after rollback, yielding 100% coverage.
forbidden: The Prior Behavior Baseline is not observed after rollback.
oracle.observable: The rollback verification artifact lists a baseline observation for each non-empty Consumer Manifest entry and reports complete coverage.

acceptance.then: Rollback is considered verified only when all non-empty manifest entries have baseline observations.
acceptance.when: Run rollback verification for the non-empty manifest and inspect the resulting per-entry baseline coverage artifact.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select a non-empty manifest rollback case with at least one entry lacking a Prior Behavior Baseline observation and require the coverage check to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: After rollback, verify and record Prior Behavior Baseline observations for 100% of non-empty Consumer Manifest entries.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema changes; rollback of implementation restores earlier post-rollback verification behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: rollback completed -> baseline observation per manifest entry -> 100% coverage gate
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Coverage artifact reports baseline_observed=true for every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry and a 100% completion ratio.
